# True Compress

> True Compress specializes in medical-grade compression socks designed to improve circulation, reduce swelling, and enhance comfort for everyday wear and travel.

True Compress offers a range of compression socks with varying support levels (measured in mmHg), made from premium materials like nylon, polyester, and spandex certified by OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100. The company ships globally to Canada, Australia, Europe, and the USA, with dedicated customer support and comprehensive product guidance.
